No canonical truth, schemas, OpenAPI, BFF runtime, or frontend files changed.

handoffs.message: Followup-6 sidecar ready for review (commit 93a8e117). Resolves Q15 (withdraw semantics: TradingRoomStore handoff additions, 404/409 guards) and Q16 (X-Request-Id required, enforcement order). New gaps Q17-Q22 from reading the now-live router.py and store.py: GovernedIntentHandoffRequest accepts server-derived fields (Q17), submit returns 'queued' not 'submitted' (Q18), no handoff storage in TradingRoomStore (Q19), If-Match/Idempotency-Key/X-Request-Id not enforced (Q20), missing ETag header on GET (Q21), withdraw silent 200 on missing intent (Q22).
Followup-6 BFF/frontend handoff packet approved for parent owner absorption.
